implementation_status.reason: Critical correction 2026-10-11: historical materials.py used np.logspace(-5, 7, 8), which is not the standard OECD/NEA C5G7 energy-group structure. Production and previous smoke MGXS files were byte-identical to that upstream output, but identity does not establish benchmark correctness. Their scalar comparison with 1.18655 is withdrawn as benchmark evidence. The corrected runner replaces the nonstandard edges with [1e-5, 0.0635, 10, 100, 1000, 500000, 1000000, 20000000] eV and audits the generated MGXS group-structure attribute before transport. A fresh corrected run and primary-specification review are required. Legacy fresh/once_burned/twice_burned labels still have no defensible mapping to C5G7 UO2/MOX compositions.

explicit_nonclaims: This manifest does not contain a complete executable OpenMC model or bundled cross-section library.
C5G7 is selected as a documented transport-code benchmark reference, not as a justified mapping for the existing abstract burnup-state QUBO.
The independently audited production statepoint is a baseline result only; it does not provide six candidate results or benchmark acceptance.
No physical CB-PFR validation or reactor-safety claim is made.
